authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Don't drift into generic Treasure or self-recursion value.
Don't rely on put-onto-battlefield effects for Treasure (they aren't casts).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Opponents' cards are weak or off-color for what you need.
Without Don stolen creatures shrink and Treasures stop.
Stolen permanents leave when their owner leaves the game.

value.protection: Greaves, free protection; Don's static vanishes with him.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Both theft axes pay off only through Don: stolen creatures become threats and stolen noncreature casts become Treasure.
accepted_role.honest_note: Power depends on what opponents play; casting from your own copies or putting cards onto the battlefield (Jhoira, Reanimate) gives no Treasure.
